findings: CVE-2026-41714 / GHSA-p8qj-fj6r-w7q9 is a real CWE-295: RabbitConnectionFactoryBean.setUri(amqps) applied the RabbitMQ client URI immediately, so TLS came up under TrustEverythingTrustManager unless the independent useSSL flag later selected setUpSSL().

Smallest surviving public atomic BIC in spring-projects/spring-amqp is 3b605cddbfd502946e841ddecd304f0ca308710f; parent 64be3f1ba86561f5af53abb0f99be25a9bbd1d4c has no RabbitConnectionFactoryBean.java.
